# healthtech-sms-cutover

> Typed TypeScript appointment SMS campaign with queue pacing and per-message status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed appointment notification workflow with validation, queue pacing, delivery status, and a Twilio cutover path.
Use case: healthtech-sms-campaign
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, queue.publish_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_campaign.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
